faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SAIL Advisor posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the SAIL Advisor posts is 19 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for the SAIL Advisor recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Advisor posts in SAIL recruitment is 65 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Advisor posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Advisor posts will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 1,00,000.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Advisor posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the Advisor posts in the Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for SAIL Advisor recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the Advisor posts?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria require candidates to be ex-executives from SAIL who have retired in E-7 or below grades, with specific grade requirements for different departments.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for SAIL Advisor recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the SAIL Advisor recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Advisor posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Advisor posts will involve a screening of applications followed by an interview of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these Advisor positions?
faq.answer: The Advisor positions are contractual in nature, offering a fixed-term engagement for the duration specified in the appointment letter.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The posts are located in Durgapur, West Bengal, with specific departmental postings as mentioned in the vacancy details.
